description: Audar-TTS-V1 voice-profile registry. Six ready-to-use synthetic voices, shared by all tiers (one prompt protocol). Each profile is a zero-shot reference: pass its clip + transcript as the REF_TEXT / REF_SPEECH conditioning. The voices were created by interpolating multiple speakers and do not replicate or resemble any real individual; they are free to use.

reference_format.conditioning: reference clip + its transcript (see the prompt protocol in the README)

custom_voices: Any consented 5-15 s clip works as a reference — zero-shot, no fine-tuning. Clone voices only with the speaker's explicit consent.
